data.cultural_impact: In the Middle Ages, Saint Peter's Basilica in Rome was a major pilgrimage site for Europeans, inspiring the popularity of the name Petka for girls. It is also the name of a village in Bulgaria, where the Petka Monastery is a significant cultural and historical landmark.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Petka is deeply symbolic of the strength and foundation that one can find in their faith. It reminds us of the unwavering loyalty and devotion of Saint Peter, who was chosen by Jesus to build His Church on the rock of his confession.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Petka, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Petka meaning "Rock, Stone" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
